surface: Client runtime surface at @preact/signals-react 3.12.0: core re-exports, useSignal/useComputed/useSignalEffect/useModel, ./runtime useSignals, and ./utils Show/For/useLiveSignal/useSignalRef over @preact/signals-core@1.14.4. wrapJsx, Signal-as-ReactElement, and the Babel react-transform plugin are explicit gaps.
divergences: wrapJsx is a no-op because Octane has no jsx-runtime to monkeypatch.
Signal.prototype is not given React $$typeof / type / props; read .value instead of rendering a Signal as a child.
Babel @preact/signals-react-transform auto-tracking is not ported; call useSignals() in components that read signals during render.
Public utils children types use OctaneNode and do not import React.
ssr: useSignals installs an empty effect store when window is undefined so server render does not subscribe. useSignal/useComputed/useModel still allocate. Client hydration starts tracking in useSyncExternalStore + layout cleanup.
